DLG a
Mama: our dinner is gone, Mio! The gulls took the fish. Go east, little one, and don't come back without a big one.

DLG b
Mama: a silver fish! You wonderful cat. Set it down by the fireplace.

DLG o
Mouse: psst. The owl in the north woods knows where the harbor key sleeps. She trades secrets for soft yarn.

DLG c
Owl: hoo. A cat with empty paws. Bring me soft yarn and I will tell you a secret worth keeping.

DLG d
Owl: ooh, lovely yarn... Listen: a shiny key sleeps in the cave below the old stone door. Take the dark stairs.

DLG f
Ghost cat: long ago I guarded the harbor key... now I only guard the dark.

DLG g
Ghost cat: you found it. Take good care of the harbor, little cousin.

DLG h
Dog: WOOF. The fisherman trades fish for coins. Somebody dropped one behind the houses. Not that I can pick it up.

DLG i
Dog: woof?? you smell AMAZING. Best cat. Ten out of ten.

DLG j
Fisherman: the sea was kind today, cat. A fish for a coin, that is the deal. No coin, no crossing to the pier.

DLG k
Fisherman: a coin! From a cat! Hop in, I will row you across. Take the fat one from the barrel.

DLG l
The harbor gate is locked tight. It needs a key.

DLG m
The fisherman blocks the plank. "No coin, no crossing."

DLG n
The fireplace crackles. Dinner spot. Still no fish.

DLG e
Mio curls up by the fire with mama. Best fish dinner ever. THE END.

DLG p
A ball of the softest yarn! An owl would love this.

DLG q
The shiny harbor key! It is cold and smells of salt.

DLG r
A lost coin! It glints like a tiny moon.

DLG s
A fat silver fish! Heavy. Perfect. Do not eat it yet.

DLG t
Catnip. For... later. Definitely for later.
